description: 變更谷關風景特定區主要計畫(公共設施用地專案通盤檢討)案 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府都市發展局. 整理公告實施「變更谷關風景特定區主要計畫（公共設施用地專案通盤檢討）案」計畫書、圖，並自111年12月2日零時起生效，請以原公告資訊為準. Coverage: 臺中市政府都市發展局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府都市發展局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-06-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
